quest.title: The Great Mountain Survey II
quest.description: Though the beacons have all been placed, Esther remains unable to measure Dragonspine's true height, seemingly due to having insufficient beacons. To resolve the issue, she is looking for someone who can help her plant a beacon directly at the mountain's summit...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Ugh, just as I expected... With only a limited number of beacons, the accuracy is nowhere near good enough. There's no way I can use this as a reliable altitude measurement.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Unless...

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: ...Unless?

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Unless a fearless adventurer can scale the highest peak and place a beacon there for me.

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: Like you! Please, help me out one more time. All my other beacons keep getting destroyed by monsters, so this is the only way to reduce the margin of error in my measurements.

response.speaker: Esther
response.text: All you need to do is place it at the summit. If you succeed, I promise I will reward you generously!

talks.objective: Place a survey beacon on Dragonspine's summit

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Brr... Th—That should d—do it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So c—cold... Can we g—go now...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Did you put the beacon in place?

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Yep.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Thank you, now I can finally get a reliable measurement of the height of the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Oh, and regarding compensation — I asked Cyrus to put something together. Ask him for it next time you're in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: And since you'll see him before I do, could you also give him this letter for me? He promised to keep me in the loop about a second exploration team headed for the mountains, but I still haven't heard back about it.

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: Once the rest of my beacons are fixed, I'll have to head back up and set them all up. There's a lot of things that still need surveying on that mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hello, how may I help?

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: I have a letter for you.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: A letter? ...Oh, it's from her. I'll wager she's asking about the next exploration team again...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't know what I can do. It's rare to find a team that's willing to take on the mountain these days — it's just too dangerous up there...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I'll write her a letter shortly to explain the situation. Thank you for making the trip to deliver this.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Speaking of letters, she sent another not long ago asking me to prepare a reward for you. Here, please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: One last thing... I can see that you are a hardy type, but nevertheless — I urge you to be careful in the mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, Dragonspine... If ever the chance arose to lead a team of explorers there in person, I would surely take it!

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: A beacon placed right at the summit will be sure to minimize the margin of error in my measurements...

dialogues.speaker: Esther
dialogues.text: *sigh* When will I finally be able to head back up the mountain...
